title: Deep-learning slide score in a multimodal recurrence score for renal cell carcinoma
summary: A deep-learning score from digitized H&E whole-slide images (development set of 651 patients) was combined with a six-SNP score and the clinicopathological Leibovich score into a multimodal recurrence score (training set of 1125 patients). Validated in 1625 independent patients and 418 patients from The Cancer Genome Atlas, it had 5-year AUCs of 0.825-0.876 for recurrence-free interval, against 0.608-0.793 for the single-modal scores and clinicopathological factors. The analysis is retrospective, and the benefit for adjuvant therapy selection is not tested.
ai_technology: Deep-learning whole-slide image score combined with SNP and clinicopathological scores
organization: Sun Yat-sen University; The First Affiliated Hospital, Sun Yat-sen University

evidence.tested: Retrospective validation in 1625 independent patients and 418 TCGA patients with recurrence-free interval as the outcome.
evidence.unknown: Prospective performance and whether it improves adjuvant treatment decisions; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning produced the histopathology whole-slide image score that was combined with the other modalities.
